title: Positioning and pricing direction
decision: Position as a grocer-only, acknowledgement-first Telegram ledger with a free core and a paid tier of roughly 20,000 to 40,000 UZS a month; stop the project if any of the three stop conditions in docs/03-market-research/OUTPUT.md is met
context: Market research found that pDaftar already offers Telegram reminders, a customer debt link and a free tier, so the approved idea is not a market gap; the remaining difference is grocer focus and per-entry customer acknowledgement, which is unproven
chosen_option: Positioning B: grocer-only, acknowledgement-first; free core plus modest paid tier
rationale: Only option with a defensible difference against a free incumbent; pricing follows the range competitors already charge; lending and payments stay out of scope
evidence: EVID-020, EVID-021, EVID-022, EVID-019, EVID-027, EVID-028, EVID-029
